column6: Beszel shows an empty SMART panel with no disks detected.  Description I am experiencing the issue on Fedora (Fedora 43). My setup:  Beszel Hub: v0.17.0 (Docker) Beszel Agent: v0.17.0 (Docker) Host OS: Fedora 43 (SELinux enforcing) Drive: NVMe (Kioxia) Docker Compose includes: privileged=true, SYS_ADMIN, SYS_RAWIO, /dev:/dev, devices=nvme0/nvme0n1, udev mounts  SMART on the host (smartctl -a /dev/nvme0) works perfectly and returns full NVMe SMART data. However, Beszel shows an empty SMART panel with no disks detected. Important notes from my testing:  SELinux permissive/enforcing makes no difference. No AVC denials appear in ausearch. NVMe devices are visible inside container. Host mode is not an option for my environment. Other Beszel features work normally.  From what I understand after reading this issue, UDisks2 on Fedora does not provide NVMe SMART attributes, so the agent cannot retrieve SMART data even with full privileges. If Beszel switches to a smartctl backend (or fallback), this should resolve the issue on Fedora, since smartctl already works correctly on the host. Just adding my environment details here so it helps with tracking. Let me know if I can provide more logs or testing. OS / Architecture OS: Fedora 43 (Linux 6.x, SELinux Enforcing) Architecture: x86_64 (Intel/AMD 64-bit) Beszel version 0.17.0 Installation method Docker Configuration No response Hub Logs No response Agent Logs No response
